args.text: Start a note to June about the PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, and Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. Post the bullets here.

args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal work), so the shorthand collides across the two accounts.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living so supervisors stop searching under the old name.

Could you confirm the account names to use on the saved report?

Thanks,
Sofia
